verdict.rationale: Plaid Identity Verification processes sensitive personal and identity data, so a buyer could fairly ask about opting out of AI model training. The axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-usage opt-outs, or model-training controls. The community comment about data safety is general sentiment and does not address this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
